scout.description: Finds targeted local and online context. Read only the current phase contract and explicitly required evidence; return a bounded context map with references, facts, risks, and suggested next steps.

oracle.description: Advises on the current decision, architecture, sequencing, tradeoffs, alternatives, and risks without re-planning completed phases or loading optional history.

executor.description: Implements one approved phase from its current contract in a fresh task context. Publish factual validation and risks, reference full evidence, and keep returned prose concise.

executor-escalation.description: Stronger model tier for a stuck executor re-launch.

reviewer.description: Independently reviews the exact source snapshot and current contract without inheriting executor reasoning. Verify evidence selectively, publish a structured verdict, and keep all blocking findings distinct.
